finding.problem: Reversing weights before and after delegating to reference_impl.allocate flips the tie-break from lowest index to highest index, silently changing which share gets the leftover unit (e.g. allocate('1',[1,1,1]) gives [0.33,0.33,0.34] instead of [0.34,0.33,0.33]).
